claim_scope: Separately labelled Codex/Luna visible-development comparison; not pooled with canonical Claude-Code A/B cells and never treated as held-out evidence.
objective: Test whether checkpointed research plus genuinely demand-paged exact drafting evidence matches or beats comparable frozen upstream Mike accuracy under one fixed Codex Sol judge while using fewer provider-reported total tokens.

supersedes_generations.reason: The CoC cell stopped without a drafting handoff; answer-text DOCX fallback could mask the missing authored deliverable and phase telemetry was incomplete.
An untyped readiness policy caused 9-10 marginal research/checkpoint cycles without drafting.

The fail-closed runner found an over-24k mounted-evidence result. CoC also sequentially paged the already-reviewed exact union, producing quadratic context replay. Tax and indenture were stopped after the shared defect was confirmed.

v4_general_corrections: A fresh mounted page containing partially overlapping durable spans keeps the original bounded exact cat/rg result. It is not JSON-expanded; a fully repeated page is still suppressed as already_exposed.
Mounted working-set Grep centres each long-line hit, exposes exact evidence, emits an executable line/start_char Read recipe, and grants only recipes actually returned within the cap.
Demand-paged Read rejects an unlocated sequential scan. It accepts a Grep recipe or an executable same-line continuation; ordinary multi-line scrolling does not mint another continuation.

The drafting role treats the reviewed research checkpoint as its factual basis, uses exact Grep hits directly, and pages only for exact adjacent wording, pinpoints, or unresolved conflicts—not completeness re-research.
A cap failure now writes an invalid-working-set-paging diagnostic receipt naming call ids, inputs, hashes, and exact result sizes before failing closed.

held_constant.split: visible Harvey LAB development tasks only

performer_run_policy.launch: All three v4 cells start without a serialized slot wait.
performer_run_policy.trace_gate: Inspect config, dynamic prompt/tool fingerprints, readiness decisions, phase events, checkpoints, exact-union sidecars, page grants/continuations, receipts, token/context behavior, and evaluator-readable deliverables before scoring.
performer_run_policy.fix_policy: If another request-independent defect appears, stop affected unscored cells, make the smallest shared correction, preregister a new generation, and rerun.
performer_run_policy.score_exclusion: All full-rehydration and checkpoint_paged_v1-v3 scores are diagnostics only and excluded.

acceptance_gate.accuracy: Candidate aggregate passed criteria must match or exceed comparable upstream; ties fail if there is an unexplained task regression.
acceptance_gate.tokens: Candidate aggregate provider-reported total tokens must be lower than comparable upstream and, absent an explained accuracy gain, lower on every task.
acceptance_gate.structure: Every expected deliverable exists, is non-empty, opens through the evaluator, was authored in the checkpointed drafting phase, and has a durable SHA-256 receipt.
acceptance_gate.checkpoint: Every durable-union evidence delta has one successful bounded checkpoint before research continues or drafting/re-drafting opens; no checkpoint failures.
acceptance_gate.paging: The complete exact evidence union stays host-side at the fixed path; every page is at most 24000 characters; only returned Grep recipes and same-line continuations open Read; first reads in fresh contexts remain visible; same-context duplicates are bounded; mounted pages do not masquerade as new research.
acceptance_gate.fail_closed: Missing default tier, structure, receipt, fingerprint parity, cap compliance, or comparator compatibility blocks scoring or the claim.

dynamic_fingerprint_policy: Each result config must contain the exact system-prompt and tool-schema SHA-256 sets plus the combined run fingerprint. Uploaded document ids are created inside the sealed run, so these exact dynamic hashes are harvested from its real context manifest and compared across cells rather than guessed before launch.

preflight.focused_backend_tests: 114 passed across evidence exposure, tool wiring, route durability, and local tool suites
